before.name: D7 retention by transcription model and recording profile
before.description: Observational comparison only. Controls by duration bucket and input source; it does not prove Heavy causes retention.

source.query:
SELECT
  model,
  duration_bucket,
  input_source,
  count() AS users,
  sum(did_return_d7) AS retained_users,
  round(sum(did_return_d7) / count(), 3) AS d7_retention
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.person_id,
    s.first_start_at,
    s.model,
    s.duration_bucket,
    s.input_source,
    countIf(
      toDate(e.timestamp) > toDate(s.first_start_at)
      AND e.timestamp <= s.first_start_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY
      AND e.event IN ('transcription_started', 'transcription_succeeded', 'transcription_imported_to_editor', 'gte_session_started', 'gte_practice_started', 'gte_editor_saved', 'product_home_viewed')
    ) > 0 AS did_return_d7
  FROM (
    SELECT
      person_id,
      min(timestamp) AS first_start_at,
      argMin(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcriptionModel), ''), 'unknown'), timestamp) AS model,
      argMin(
        multiIf(
          coalesce(toFloat(properties.durationSec), 0) <= 30, '0-30s',
          coalesce(toFloat(properties.durationSec), 0) <= 120, '31-120s',
          coalesce(toFloat(properties.durationSec), 0) <= 300, '121-300s',
          '300s+'
        ),
        timestamp
      ) AS duration_bucket,
      argMin(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.input_source), ''), nullIf(toString(properties.mode), ''), 'unknown'), timestamp) AS input_source
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
      AND event = 'transcription_started'
    GROUP BY person_id
  ) AS s
  LEFT JOIN events AS e ON s.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
    AND s.first_start_at <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  GROUP BY s.person_id, s.first_start_at, s.model, s.duration_bucket, s.input_source
)
GROUP BY model, duration_bucket, input_source
ORDER BY users DESC
LIMIT 100

changes.name: Light starts: Basic Pitch vs MuScriptor Small
changes.description: Separate series for historical Basic Pitch Light and new MuScriptor Small Light. New MuScriptor events begin after the frontend deployment; historical events remain unchanged.
Starts by actual model implementation: basic_pitch (legacy Light), msmodel_small (new Light), yourmt3 (retired Medium), msmodel (Heavy). Historical ids are mapped at query time.

source.query: SELECT coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_backend_method), ''), nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_implementation), ''), multiIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'msmodel_small', 'msmodel_small', coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'light', 'basic_pitch', coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'heavy', 'yourmt3', coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'super_heavy', 'msmodel', 'unknown')) AS model, count() AS starts FROM events WHERE event='transcription_started' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY model ORDER BY starts DESC
